blocks.html: The 3-Day Marketing Masterclass is ideal for beginners, job seekers, aspiring digital marketers, new entrepreneurs, small business owners, freelancers, creatives, students, and course creators who want a clear, structured understanding of how to attract, engage, convert, and retain customers effectively.

1. Advertising: Create powerful ads that sell
- Facebook, Instagram, TikTok, Google, Twitter & Snapchat Ads

a. Audience Targeting Mastery
b. How to spend less for more
c. A/B testing ad creatives
d. Budgeting: daily vs lifetime budgets
e. Right platform to use for the right business
f. Facebook Pixel / Conversion API / GTM (Google Tag Manager)
g. Google Keyword Planner, Facebook Audience Targeting, and more

2. Promotion: How to use deals & discounts to attract buyers

a. Sales Promotion
b. Incentive-based Promotion
c. Event-based Promotion
d. Digital Promotion
e. Experience Promotion,
f. Lines not to cross in promotions, and more

a. Types of Publicity

a. The Foundation Of Effective PR

c. Media Relations
d. Digital PR & Personal Branding

f. Sponsorships and Partnerships, and more

5. Sales: How to master the art of closing deals

a. Introduction to SALES, and Sales tactics
b. SALES FUNNEL
c. Customer Journey
d. Customer Insight
e. Customer Persona
f. Closing techniques, and more
